task_prompt:
You are a data analyst. Answer the following data analysis question by writing Python code to load and analyze the provided CSV file.

## Available data files
  - ./data/auto-mpg.csv

## Question
1. Identify the vehicle with the highest horsepower and provide its corresponding model year. Calculate the average horsepower along with the standard deviation for all vehicles within the same model year as this vehicle.

## Constraints
For the "average horsepower", calculate it using the arithmetic mean formula. Calculate the standard deviation using the population standard deviation formula, not the sample standard deviation formula. Round both measures to two decimal places.

## Expected answer format
@highest_horsepower_vehicle[vehicle_model_year]
@average_horsepower[same_year_avg_horsepower]
@standard_deviation[same_year_horsepower_std]
where "vehicle_model_year" is an integer from 1900 to the current year. "same_year_avg_horsepower" and "same_year_horsepower_std" are numbers rounded to two decimal places.

After analyzing the data, submit your answer with final_answer(your_answer_here) in the specified format.

# Filter vehicles from the same model year
same_year_vehicles = df[df['modelyear'] == vehicle_model_year]

print(f"Number of vehicles in model year {vehicle_model_year}: {len(same_year_vehicles)}")
print(f"\nHorsepower values for model year {vehicle_model_year}:")
print(same_year_vehicles['horsepower'].values)

# Calculate arithmetic mean (average horsepower)
average_horsepower = same_year_vehicles['horsepower'].mean()
print(f"\nAverage horsepower: {average_horsepower}")

# Calculate population standard deviation (not sample)
# Population std formula: sqrt(sum((x - mean)^2) / N)
horsepower_values = same_year_vehicles['horsepower'].values
population_std = np.std(horsepower_values, ddof=0)  # ddof=0 for population std
print(f"Population standard deviation: {population_std}")

# Round to 2 decimal places
average_horsepower_rounded = round(average_horsepower, 2)
population_std_rounded = round(population_std, 2)

print(f"\nRounded average horsepower: {average_horsepower_rounded}")
print(f"Rounded population standard deviation: {population_std_rounded}")

# Convert model year to full year (assuming 70 = 1970, 73 = 1973, etc.)
# The data shows years as 70-82, which likely represent 1970-1982
full_year = int(1900 + vehicle_model_year)
print(f"\nFull model year: {full_year}")
